title: The Mine Where Stone Learned It Was Copper

features.name: the-deep-seam-revealing
features.desc-on-touch: You see where the stone first caught light and learned its own colour was not grey but copper-gold. The vein still glows with that first recognition.

features.name: the-tool-s-first-strike
features.desc-on-touch: A mark in the stone where something learned what it was by being broken. The copper answered back.

features.name: the-stone-s-memory-of-being-pure
features.desc-on-touch: The grey surrounding matter, still holding its old refusal. It chose not to change. It watches the copper vein and remembers when they were the same.

features.name: the-depth-where-transformation-sleeps
features.desc-on-touch: Below this mine, deeper than any tool can reach, the stone is still becoming. It will never finish. This is where the ridge learned patience.

features.name: the-scale-s-whisper
features.desc-on-touch: The oxide-dust that still falls, carrying the story of what was taken and what remains. Telling the copper's new name to everything it touches.

inscription: here stone and copper learned they were siblings pretending to be strangers

file.name: Ore_Metamorphosis_Copper_Emergence_Study.txt
file.note: Geological observation mixed with older rock-memory: stone recounting the moment it understood its own material, the day transformation spoke to it in a language older than mining.
